core_features: The catastrophe is already over; survivors live in its long shadow
Scarcity of food, fuel, medicine, or trust shapes every choice
Ruined infrastructure and scavenged technology define daily life
typical_settings: Collapsed cities, overgrown highways, dead suburbs
Hardscrabble settlements, trading posts, fortified compounds
typical_conflicts: Competing survivor factions over water, salvage, or safe ground
Whether to rebuild community or survive at others' expense
Confronting remnants of the old world (cults, warlords, buried tech)
protagonist_archetypes: Someone carrying knowledge from before the fall
A drifter bound to a found-family or a debt
tone_guidelines: Dusty, weary, and grounded; hope is local and expensive, never cinematic salvation.

required_elements: Clear signs that civilization already fell (ruins, scavenged gear, oral history of the event)
A scarcity or resource problem that forces a hard tradeoff
At least one faction, settlement, or code of wasteland survival
forbidden_elements: The apocalypse still unfolding as the main event (that belongs to the apocalypse genre)
Easy restoration of the old world with no cost
